detail: HDF5 exports contain flattened samples and parameter names but no walker/time dimensions, burn-in, thinning, seed, weights, or log probability.
The public script contains site-specific absolute paths, the README names an absent example config, and no pinned runtime dependency manifest is supplied.
Paper ΛCDM2b corresponds to release LambdaCDM2d; release LambdaCDM2b is the SLACS-only intermediate posterior.
Nested posterior shifts share time-delay data and hierarchical assumptions; they are dependency diagnostics, not independent significances or causal likelihood contributions.
The public TDCOSMO posteriors remain broad and do not establish a resolution, correction, or new-physics explanation.
